start.note: “āāa neràu 35. seχem …” (“Mighty of victories, Power of …”), p. 135 row 7 from its fifth word, right after ani-015-c's “t'eft'ef”

end.note: … Thebes Ani, triumphant, with them. (p. 137 row 9, the end of Chapter XV; p. 138 begins Chapter CXXXIII with its own line “1.”)

sections: One continuous run of Ani's text, Chapter XV, Plate XXI, no Appendix and no footnotes: p. 135 row 7 (from āāa) to row 9, p. 136 rows 1–9, p. 137 rows 1–9 to the end of the chapter (“ḥenā - sen”, “with them.”). Line numerals 35.–49. continue from ani-015-c. parts.json had pp. 136–138; the part starts on p. 135 row 7 where ani-015-c stopped and ends with the chapter on p. 137, p. 138 being the next chapter (ani-133). Budge's “.....” before χer on p. 137 row 2 stands over an empty space in the sign line (no signs, no brackets); it is noted on χer.
